## 🧭 The Problem This Solves

> Most CRM backends built for small and medium-sized businesses are **reactive** — they store what happened, run basic CRUD, and stop there. When they do offer AI, it's usually a black-box prediction with no explanation, bolted onto a system that can't act on its own conclusions.

**NextGen CRM's backend** was built as a Final Year Project to be the opposite: an engine that plans, predicts, *explains*, and *executes* — not just persists.

---

## ⚡ How the Intelligence Layer Actually Works

### 🎯 Goal-Driven Task Execution (Agentic AI)

```
1. User submits:     "Follow up with all at-risk customers this week"
                              │
2. Goal Parser:      Sends the goal + live agent context to Groq's
                      Llama 3.3 70B, which returns a structured task plan
                              │
3. Human review:      Every task is returned to the frontend for approval
                      BEFORE execution — nothing runs blind
                              │
4. CrewAI executes:   Agents invoke 7 real tools — web search (Tavily),
                      email (Gmail SMTP), Slack alerts, CRM read/write,
                      calendar booking, analytics
                              │
5. Results logged:    Task outcomes, execution time, and full audit
                      trail written back to the database
```

### 🔀 Automation (Workflow Builder — fully functional, not a mockup)

1. The frontend gives users a **visual canvas** with 6 node types — Trigger, Delay, Action, Condition, and more
2. Users drag, drop, and connect nodes to define custom automation logic
3. Hitting **Run** persists the workflow and activates it on the backend
4. The backend executes it — this is a real execution engine, not a design-only prototype

### 😐 Emotion Detection (automatic, event-driven)

Wired directly into Django's **signal framework** (`signals.py`) — when a new email arrives via the Gmail integration, emotion detection runs automatically against the message content with zero manual trigger required.

### 🧠 Explainable AI (XAI — automatic, event-driven)

Also signal-driven: the moment a new lead is added, the backend automatically explains the AI's reasoning —

- **Lead conversion scoring** → XGBoost model, explained with **SHAP** (TreeExplainer)
- **Deal outcome prediction** → Random Forest model, explained with **LIME**

No black-box scores here — every prediction ships with a human-readable "why."

## 🏗️ System Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    subgraph Presentation["🖥️ Presentation Layer"]
        FE["React 18 SPA (Vite)<br/>Axios + JWT interceptors"]
    end

    subgraph Gateway["🔌 Application & API Gateway Tier"]
        AUTH["Stateless JWT Auth"]
        DRF["Django REST Framework<br/>Viewsets + Serializers"]
        CORS["django-corsheaders"]
    end

    subgraph Intelligence["🧠 Intelligence & Multi-Agent Orchestration Tier"]
        CREW["CrewAI Orchestrator"]
        LITELLM["LiteLLM Router"]
        GROQ["Groq API<br/>Llama 3.3 70B"]
        TOOLS["7 Agent Tools"]
        XAI["XAI Engine<br/>SHAP + LIME"]
        EMO["Emotion Detection<br/>(Django Signals)"]
    end

    subgraph Async["⚙️ Async Processing"]
        CELERY["Celery Workers"]
        BEAT["Celery Beat Scheduler"]
        REDIS[("Redis Broker")]
    end

    subgraph Persistence["🗄️ Data Vault Layer"]
        DB[("PostgreSQL 15<br/>Supabase · AWS Tokyo")]
    end

    FE -->|REST API calls| CORS --> DRF
    DRF --> AUTH
    DRF -->|goal submitted| CREW
    CREW --> LITELLM --> GROQ
    CREW --> TOOLS
    CREW --> CELERY
    CELERY --> REDIS
    BEAT --> CELERY
    DRF -->|new lead created| XAI
    DRF -->|email received| EMO
    DRF --> DB
    CREW --> DB
    XAI --> DB
```

<summary><strong>🔍 Show / hide details</strong></summary>

### 2. 🤝 CRM Operations

<details open>
<summary><strong>🔍 Show / hide details</strong></summary>
<br/>

| Entity | Key Details |
|---|---|
| **Leads** | 6 pipeline stages, 6 source types, AI-generated probability scores via weighted-value computation |
| **Contacts** | Linked to Company records, star ratings, semantic tags, last-contact tracking |
| **Companies** | 4 type classifications, 4 operational health statuses |
| **Deals** | 4-stage Kanban (New, Prospect, Proposal, Won) |

| **Contracts Management** | Agreement lifecycle + renewal tracking |

| **Feedback & Surveys** | Automated NPS recalculation |

</details>

### 3. 🧠 Artificial Intelligence

<details open>
<summary><strong>🔍 Show / hide details</strong></summary>
<br/>

| Feature | Implementation |
|---|---|
| **AI Recommendation Engine** | Next-best-action suggestions based on historical CRM patterns |
| **Emotion Detection System** | Django-signal-triggered — runs automatically on every incoming email via the Gmail integration |
| **Explainable AI (XAI)** | Signal-triggered on lead creation — XGBoost lead scoring explained via **SHAP TreeExplainer**; Random Forest deal-outcome prediction explained via **LIME** |

### 4. 🤖 Agentic AI & Automation

<details open>
<summary><strong>🔍 Show / hide details</strong></summary>
<br/>

- **Resource model** — defines agent personas: roles, goals, backstories, allowed tools
- **AgentConfig** — per-agent LLM parameters (model selection across 4 Groq models, temperature, max_tokens, skills, priority)
- **Goal Parser** — plain-English objective → structured JSON task plan
- **7 registered tools**: `TavilySearchTool`, `EmailSendTool`, `CRMReadTool`, `CRMWriteTool`, `SlackNotifyTool`, `CalendarBookTool`, `AnalyticsTool`
- **AgentMemory** — three-tier cognitive memory (short-term, long-term, episodic) with importance scoring
- **Workflow Execution Engine** — persists and runs workflows built on the frontend's 6-node visual canvas (Trigger, Delay, Action, Condition, and more) — **fully functional**, not design-only
- **Monitoring** — `BottleneckAlert` and `MonthlyPerformance` tracking per agent

</details>

<details open>
<summary><strong>🔍 Show / hide details</strong></summary>
<br/>

Data Integration & ETL Management · Business Intelligence · KPI & Dashboard Management · Sales Analytics · Customer Analytics · Marketing Analytics · Operational Analytics · Predictive Analytics & Forecasting · Model Monitoring & AI Analytics (tracks health/accuracy of the XGBoost and Random Forest models in production)

### 6. 👥 HRM

<details open>
<summary><strong>🔍 Show / hide details</strong></summary>
<br/>

Employee → Department/Designation mapping (PROTECT-on-delete integrity) · Attendance with duplicate-entry constraints · 4-type, 4-status Leave approval workflow · Performance Reviews · 6-stage Recruitment pipeline (Jobs Post, Candidates) · Promotions · Resignations (7 reason types) · Terminations (6 codes) · Payroll (base salary + allowances − deductions)

</details>

---

### 7. 💰 Finance & Accounting

<details open>
<summary><strong>🔍 Show / hide details</strong></summary>
<br/>

Full double-entry bookkeeping across 7 sub-apps:

Chart of Accounts (self-referencing hierarchy, 5 account types) · General Ledger (enforced debit=credit balance rule) · Accounts Payable (multi-step approval) · Accounts Receivable (6 status states) · Cash & Bank (automated reconciliation) · Invoice & Billing · Expense Management (hierarchical classification tied to COA) · Payroll · Asset Management · Financial Statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow)

</details>

---

### 8. 🔐 Security & System

<details open>
<summary><strong>🔍 Show / hide details</strong></summary>
<br/>

- **49-entry RBAC permission matrix**: 7 modules × 7 action types
- **Immutable AuditLog** — overrides Django's `save()` to raise `PermissionError` on any update attempt
- **8-step auth verification flow**: IP check → brute-force throttling → credential match → MFA → JWT issuance → session creation → login history
- `SecurityPolicy` singleton (12 configurable preferences) and `SystemSetting` singleton (branding, feature flags)
- JWT authentication with automatic silent token refresh

</details>

> 📌 Every module above maps 1:1 to real Django apps in `crmapp/` — this isn't a spec sheet, it's the actual codebase structure.

## 🛠️ Tech Stack

<div align="center">

| Layer | Technology |
|:---:|:---:|
| **Backend Framework** | Django 4.x + Django REST Framework |
| **Language** | Python 3.12 |
| **Database** | PostgreSQL 15 (Supabase, AWS Tokyo) |
| **Async Queue** | Celery + Redis, Celery Beat |
| **Agent Orchestration** | CrewAI |
| **LLM Routing** | LiteLLM → Groq API (Llama 3.3 70B) |
| **Explainability** | SHAP (TreeExplainer), LIME |
| **ML Models** | XGBoost (lead scoring), Random Forest (deal outcome) |
| **Auth** | SimpleJWT (30-min access / 7-day refresh) |
| **External Tools** | Tavily (search), Gmail SMTP, Slack Webhooks |

</div>

## ⚡ Getting Started

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Muhammad-Hashir-Khalil-Yousafzai/nextgen-crm-backend.git
cd nextgen-crm-backend

python -m venv venv
venv\Scripts\activate      # Windows
source venv/bin/activate   # macOS/Linux

pip install -r requirements.txt

cp .env.example .env
# Fill in your own values

python manage.py migrate
python manage.py runserver

# Separate terminals:
celery -A backend worker --pool=solo -l info
celery -A backend beat -l info
```

---

## 🔑 Environment Variables

All secrets are pulled from environment variables — see `.env.example` for the full list (database credentials, Groq/Tavily API keys, Gmail SMTP, Slack webhook, Google OAuth). **Never commit a real `.env` file.**

## ⚠️ Known Limitations

Reported transparently:

- Built and tested with **synthetic data only** — real-world performance with live business data hasn't been validated
- **Supabase security isn't hardened yet** — data isn't fully locked down at the database level
- **Groq API runs on a free-tier key** — heavy concurrent usage may hit rate limits
- **Performance under high data volume** hasn't been optimized or load-tested at scale

---

## 🗺️ Roadmap

- [ ] Harden Supabase-level security (RLS policies, connection pooling limits)
- [ ] Move off Groq free tier / add fallback LLM provider for rate-limit resilience
- [ ] Load-test and optimize for high-volume datasets
- [ ] Docker Compose for one-command deployment
- [ ] Multi-tenancy support
